Launching on October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, and day one on Xbox Game Pass, Gears of War: E-Day chronicles the first disastrous encounter between the humans living on the world of Sera and the Locust. The developers behind it recently spoke to GameSpot about a wide range of topics, from solving lore problems to how you strip the flesh off of enemies in the game's new take on Horde mode, and it looks like there's even a Smash Mouth-inspired achievement that you can earn if you want to be a real all-star.

title: Street Fighter Movie’s Popcorn Bucket Is Absolutely Perfect. No Notes.
text:
Popcorn buckets for movies are all the rage today. Basically every big movie has one. But they aren't all created equally. One popcorn bucket that looks like it could be the best one yet is for this October's Street Fighter movie.
Revealed today by Cody Rhodes, the Street Fighter popcorn bucket, which will be exclusive to AMC locations, is modeled after his character Guile's epic hair. The popcorn goes in the bucket, and then you can put it on your head and grab the popcorn from up there. Or you can plop it in your lap and eat the popcorn normally. In a word, the popcorn bucket is perfect . If you need three words, Rhodes said the popcorn bucket is "aerodynamic, ergonomic, delicious."
Check out the glorious announcement video for the Street Fighter popcorn bucket below.
https://twitter.com/CodyRhodes/status/2100619500072686014
Tickets for the Street Fighter movie go on sale this coming Monday, September, 21. Presumably that's also when people can reserve one of these popcorn buckets, so the price should be revealed soon.
The Street Fighter movie releases in theaters on October 16. In addition to Rhodes as Guile, the film features Noah Centineo as Ken, Andrew Koji as Ryu, Roman Reigns as Akuma, Jason Momoa as Blanka, 50 Cent as Balrog, David Dastmalchian as M. Bison, and Eric Andre as Don Sauvage.
The film is directed by Kitao Sakurai, who is known for his work on The Eric Andre Show, Twisted Metal, and Beef.
While the Street Fighter movie isn't releasing until October, the next video game movie, Resident Evil, hits theaters on September 18--it's getting rave reviews .

title: Roblox Movie 99 Nights In The Forest Brings On Oscar-Winning Toy Story 4 Director
text:
The upcoming 99 Nights in the Forest movie, based on the super-popular Roblox survival-horror game, has reportedly brought on a very big name.
According to The Hollywood Reporter , 20th Century Studios--which is owned by Disney--has hired Josh Cooley to write the script. Cooley directed the Oscar-winning Pixar movie Toy Story 4. He also earned an Academy Award nomination for Inside Out. Beyond Disney movies, Cooley directed Transformers One.
99 Nights in the Forest is coming to the big screen.
99 Nights in the Forest is developed by Grandma's Favourite Games and exists on the Roblox platform. It remains one of the platform's most popular games , boasting nearly 150,000 players right this moment.
20th Century bought the rights earlier this year following what was reported to have been a "competitive" dealmaking process.
A survival game, 99 Nights in the Forest has players trying to survive for 99 nights in a haunted forest as they fight monsters and save missing children. The developers behind the game–Alec Kieft, Matthew Hufton, and Cameron Angland–will be executive producers for the movie.
20th Century was also behind the Hitman and Assassin's Creed movies, so 99 Nights in the Forest is not the studio's first video game film.
99 Nights in the Forest is also not the first game hosted on Roblox to get a movie deal, as  Grow a Garden  and  Steal a Brainrot  also landed Hollywood development deals.

title: Scientists Discovered A New Cat Before Rockstar Could Finish GTA 6
text:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has been in development since 2015 , and a lot of things have happened since then, including the recent discovery a new species of cat.
The scientific journal Current Biology disclosed the discovery of Leopardus tilcayo--known as the tilcayo tiger cat--this week. The adorable little creature is smaller than your typical housecat, featuring spots and round ears. According to the discovery, the cat species was found in the Bolivian Yungas forest.
The tilcayo tiger cat is the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years.
https://twitter.com/NatGeo/status/2100601922168209413
Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, a co-author of the report, told NBC News that it is currently unknown how many of the cats remain in the wild. She said she discovered the cat basically by accident. She volunteers at a wildlife rehab facility close to La Paz, Bolivia and noticed a tiny cat that she thought was a kitten.
The cat was brought to the facility by a man who was caring for it, feeding it rice and eggs, and later giving it up when he was unable to care for it. Genetic testing was undertaken, and it was discovered that it was indeed a brand-new species of cat never before discovered or documented.
As for more gaming-related things that have happened since GTA 5 came out, GameSpot recently assembled a collection of some of the biggest news stories, including Halo coming to PlayStation, the release of 15+ Call of Duty games, the entire run of Phil Spencer as Xbox CEO , and more.
The wait for GTA 6 has been so long that it's spawned the, “We got ___ before GTA VI” meme. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick said he is aware of these memes. “I’ve seen some of those," he said .
The wait for GTA 6 is nearly over, as the game is scheduled for release on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game will not ship on a disc, but if you want a disc with GTA 6 printed on it, you can buy the game's soundtrack .

title: GTA 6 Will Feature The “Next Evolution Of In-Game Radio,” Rockstar Says
text:
Tucked away at the bottom of Rockstar's blog post today announcing GTA 6: The Album was a line about other updates to come for the game regarding its sound and music.
Rockstar said fans should "stay tuned for more details about the music of GTA 6," and specifically the game's "dynamic score." Additionally, Rockstar teased that GTA 6 will feature the "next evolution of in-game radio, and more."
This does not tell us a whole lot. However, it was previously rumored that GTA 6 will feature people like  DJ Khaled hosting his own in-game radio station . Drake, meanwhile,  may have his own station, too . Beyond this, another unconfirmed rumor claimed that Rockstar will allow Spotify subscribers to import their own playlists into GTA 6.
A previous trailer for GTA 6 showed Lucia wearing earbuds. People theorized that this could mean players will be able to listen to music while walking around, instead of only while driving.
Lucia and Jason in GTA 6.
Spotify has been heavily promoting GTA 6 already , so the two companies are clearly already working together, but it remains to be seen how deep the partnership might be.
In any event, the GTA series is known for its music and artist collaborations, so it would be no surprise to see Rockstar up the ante with GTA 6. The upcoming GTA 6 album features 34 songs written for GTA 6, including new music from Keith Richards and Travis Scott .
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with a PC edition expected to follow sometime later .

title: New GTA 5 Source Code Leak Is Uncovering A Ton Of Cut Content
text:
A huge batch of previously leaked Rockstar files has resurfaced online, giving players a new look at Grand Theft Auto 5' s canceled content, including a surprisingly massive Liberty City expansion and the long-rumored Agent Trevor DLC.
The files reportedly total around 192GB, dwarfing the roughly 4GB collection of GTA 5 source code material that surfaced publicly in 2023. GTA modder TJGM has been digging through the newly accessible files and has already highlighted several discoveries, including cut dialogue, canceled missions, development tools, and assets from Rockstar's planned single-player expansions.
One of the biggest discoveries so far is a look at the Liberty City expansion that Rockstar had planned for GTA 5, but ultimately was canned.
TJGM shared an outline of the Liberty City expansion, reconstructed using shoreline data contained in the files. The map appears substantially larger than the Liberty City featured in GTA 4. "The outline of this map is drawn based on where shorelines are," TJGM explained, noting that the files also contain zones associated with shoreline audio.
The discovery provides a clearer picture of how ambitious Rockstar's plans were for bringing Liberty City into GTA 5.
Trevor could have had a James Bond-style mission.
Another file reportedly contains a development zone that suggests Rockstar had begun setting up additional terrain for the expansion. The presence of the map outline and audio zones could indicate that development progressed considerably further than previously known.
The Liberty City content was already known to exist thanks to the 2023 source-code leak, but the new material provides a clearer picture of its intended scale. It also raises the possibility that Rockstar's plans for Liberty City could be pushed toward GTA 6, although that remains purely speculation at this point.
The leak also sheds more light on another canceled GTA 5 project: the Agent Trevor DLC. The DLC was set to star GTA 5's Trevor as a secret agent, but it was later confirmed that it had been canceled due to increased interest in GTA Online. The new leak shares interior screenshots that were apparently intended for the expansion, including a large mansion. The files also contain mission names and descriptions for the canceled single-player content, as well as information about music used during the missions.
Not everything being uncovered related to canceled expansions, though, as TJGM has also posted early dialogue from GTA 5, including an alternate version of a scene involving Michael and Tracey from the mission "Friend Request." In the unused version, Tracey is watching a fictional TV show called "Jersey Jews" rather than the Fame or Shame content that ultimately appeared in the game.
Alternate dialogue for GTA 5 has been discovered.
Some material being shared isn't simply a collection of screenshots. TJGM has explained that certain images were produced by viewing data in an external program used to inspect the game files and then capturing what was displayed. The files also reportedly contain Rockstar's development tools and other material that can be independently examined.
Perhaps inevitably, the topic of GTA 6 has cropped up. TJGM claims that the new files contain screenshots of the GTA 6 map, although they are reportedly rendered at very low quality. The existence of early GTA 6 material isn't surprising, though. The files originate from the wider Rockstar breach in 2022, during which an attacker obtained a huge quantity of Rockstar development data. At the time, reports indicated that GTA 5's source code had been compromised, along with early GTA 6 material.
GTA 5 ultimately became one of Rockstar's most heavily supported games, but much of the post-launch attention went toward GTA Online rather than the substantial single-player DLC fans were expecting. The resurfaced source code material offers a glimpse at what could have been.
With the GTA 6 release date fast approaching, the timing makes these discoveries pretty interesting. More than a decade after its launch, Rockstar's old development files are still revealing pieces of the game that we were never supposed to see.

title: Far Cry TV Series Adds Batman, Knuckles McGinty, And More Big Names
text:
The Far Cry TV series for FX is starting to take shape, as new cast members for the anthology series have been announced. Joining Rob Mac (who is also a co-showrunner alongside Noah Hawley) are Lizzy Caplan and Steve Buscemi, along with several new faces, including Brendan Gleeson, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Hamish Linklater, Jamie Demetriou, and Sam Spruell.
According to FX, all of those actors will appear in the first season of Far Cry, making for a pretty stacked cast. Leigh earned acclaim for her roles in Hateful Eight and Fargo, Spruell was recently seen in Game of Thrones: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, Demetriou will be a familiar face to anyone who is a fan of Only Murders in the Building, and Linklater's distinctive voice can be heard in Batman: Caped Crusader, where he plays the Dark Knight. Gleeson is also a big name, having recently starred in Spider-Noir and The Banshees of Inisherin, but if we're talking absolute cinema, you'll know him best for his role as Knuckles McGinty in Paddington 2.
Like the games the FX series is adapting, the Far Cry TV series aims to introduce new settings and characters  in each season, so you likely won't want to get too attached to any of the actors in the show's first batch of episodes. As for the Far Cry game series, things have been very quiet since 2021, following the release of Far Cry 6. Ubisoft is reportedly working on Far Cry 7, with the IP now falling under the umbrella of Creative House 1 AKA Vantage Studios .
Alongside other big Ubisoft IP like Assassin’s Creed and Rainbow Six, Vantage Studios is focused on scaling and extending these established franchises. Chinese multinational technology and entertainment conglomerate Tencent also holds a significant stake in the subsidiary, having invested $1 billion in it.

title: The Resident Evil Movie Is Already Breaking Records
text:
The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger officially releases today, September 18, but like many big movies, it actually debuted the night prior. The movie made $9 million or more in the US for its Thursday previews, according to Deadline , and that's a record for the series.
Experts predict the movie will make between $40 million and $50 million for its first weekend in the US, and now it could go higher, the report said.
Austin Abrams in Resident Evil.
The previous record for a first-weekend Thursday-night haul in the Resident Evil series was $1 million for 2016's Resident Evil: The Final Chapter. No other entry in the series eclipsed $1 million for Thursday previews.
Resident Evil's Thursday previews are pacing well ahead of Cregger's last movie, Weapons, which made $5.75 million in previews and went on to earn $43.5 million for its first weekend in the US.
According to Deadline, the Resident Evil movie had a budget of $75 million, but that does not count marketing expenses. Also worth mentioning is that the Thursday numbers for Resident Evil are based on Deadline's "distribution sources," and not official numbers from the studio.
The Resident Evil movie is getting rave reviews, including an 8/10 from GameSpot . In fact, Resident Evil is now the highest-rated video game adaptation ever .
Cregger has said he has ideas for more Resident Evil movies , but he's also mentioned how he's done with franchise films . He has said he did not fully appreciate how much hardcore fans of the Resident Evil games would reject his idea for his movie , which does not feature any characters or stories from the games.

title: Blacksmiths Discover Control Resonant’s Massive Hammer Is Simply Too Much Hammer
text:
The best tool you can own in life is a hammer, and in Control Resonant , fixing Manhattan requires a VERY big one to perform some percussive maintenance. The Aberrant is the melee weapon that you'll wield in battle, and while it can take a variety of forms, it looks especially satisfying to morph it into a gigantic hammer that wouldn't look out of place in a Looney Tunes cartoon if Rob Zombie were directing it. But what would that version of the Aberrant look like in real life? Pretty intimidating and impractical, it turns out.
Ahead of Control Resonant's release next week, the blacksmiths of Man at Arms took a stab at building the Aberrant. In an episode of their YouTube series--and sponsored by Control Resonant developer Remedy Entertainment--the team put together a solid replica, but for the hammerhead itself, they used hollow steel panels and advanced welding techniques to recreate the Aberrant. It's not hard to see why, because having a solid chunk of metal the size of an armchair would make it challenging to work with, let alone wield.
Even with the finished hammer employing a few techniques to keep its overall weight under control, it was still too heavy for even the burliest blacksmith to pick up or even swing around for a few test smashes. For now, it's the world's coolest-looking paperweight.
https://youtu.be/YtrZWU_S62c
Launching on September 24-- or September 22 if you spring for the PS5 Deluxe Edition--Control Resonant is already earning high reviews. On GameSpot's sister site, Metacritic , the PS5 version of the game currently has a metascore of 84 from 48 reviews, making it one of the best games of 2026 according to critical consensus. One of its big draws is that it successfully blends the signature weirdness of Remedy's growing universe of interconnected titles with highly engaging gameplay.
"Alongside the stellar art direction and a surprisingly touching story, Control Resonant’s gameplay loop feels more mainstream than anything this team has made since Max Payne," Mark Delaney wrote in GameSpot's Control Resonant review .

title: Sony Says Free TV On PS5 Is “One Plus One Equaling A Lot More Than Two”
text:
Sony recently launched "Live TV on PS5," an offering that gives all PlayStation 5 owners access to 100+ channels of free ad-supported TV and movies. Keith Le Goy, the chairman of Sony Pictures TV, recently discussed the reasoning behind launching the service and why he believes it represents "one plus one equaling a lot more than two."
Speaking to Variety , Le Goy said PS5 already has 40-50 million people who are "incredibly engaged" with gaming, but also love movies and TV shows. Therefore, he said the company saw an opportunity to target these people, who might not otherwise watch linear TV. He said this is a "very hard-to-reach audience," and also one that is "very attractive" to advertisers.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txpaWqfcFFU
People can watch anything on the Live TV on PS5 platform for free, in exchange for sitting through ads. It works similarly to other free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) services, including Tubi, Roku, and Pluto.
As with most things in life, Live TV on PS5 came about in part to make money, and Le Goy said he believes Sony can achieve big success here, if it executes.
“So if we can give that audience something that they’re going to like in an environment that they are comfortable with, give our channel partners an audience that they are going to be going after and give their advertisers an audience that’s valuable for them," he said. "That is one plus one equaling a lot more than two."
The executive went on to say Sony is uniquely positioned for success here because the company also owns PlayStation. There are precious few groups of people as passionate and dedicated as gamers, and Le Goy said this could translate to big success if Live TV on PS5 works out.
“That’s the other thing that Sony has, that frankly a lot of other companies would love to have, is a gaming business and the level of engagement with gamers and gaming fans. That is what PlayStation has.”
Sony tried live TV on PS5 before with its PlayStation Vue service. However, that was a paid service that asked people to pay at least $50/month, at a time when people were increasingly cord-cutting. Vue officially shut down in 2020 .

title: Nintendo Says We’re Still At The Beginning Of The Switch 2 Story
text:
The Switch 2 is a little over a year old, and unsurprisingly, Nintendo says that its console is just getting started. In a new interview, Nintendo of America president and COO Devon Pritchard teased a multiyear plan for the company, revolving not only around producing video games but also expanding its IP into other forms of entertainment.
"We're at the beginning of Nintendo Switch 2," Pritchard said to Variety . "This is just beginning, and we've already had some really wonderful experiences, both ours and third-party, come to the table, and I can't wait to see what the system is going to do and what our talented developers will bring to the table. But again, those partnerships and touchpoints with companies like Sony and Sony Pictures around how we can bring those experiences more broadly to not only our current players and fans but to new ones, I think that's one of the most exciting things for us over the next few years."
While video game hardware from Nintendo and its competitors typically had a shelf life of around five years, those days are long gone. The Switch launched in 2017 and was around well into the 2020s before the Switch 2 arrived in mid-2025. Nintendo was aware of the potential longevity of its console as far back as 2018, and in 2022, Nintendo president Shuntaro Furukawa said that the Switch had only reached the halfway point of its life-cycle.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O3ksQeOLW6A
The console is still being sold alongside the Switch 2, and thanks to it being relatively cheaper than its successor even after recent price hikes , it's a solid option for anyone on a budget, depending on which model you choose. It also has an impressive library of games , making it a tempting last-gen purchase, and Nintendo has yet to announce when it'll be discontinued.
In the years since Nintendo launched the Switch, it has also expanded how it does business, monetizing virtually every part of its operations, from monthly subscriptions for Nintendo Switch Online services to charging several bucks for Switch games to get a Switch 2 upgrade. We've also seen it slowly expand into the world of movies, as it has partnered with Despicable Me's Illumination to produce two highly profitable Super Mario movies so far. The Super Mario Bros. Movie made over $1 billion at the global box office in 2023, and its sequel, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, made an even bigger splash with $1.3 billion.
Nintendo's next big movie is a live-action adaptation of The Legend of Zelda , and upcoming games for the Switch 2 include highly anticipated titles like The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and a new mainline Pokemon game .

title: Twitch负责人称厂商避开《GTA6》是「正确之举」
text:
相关文章: 《GTA Online》将在《GTA6》发售后继续获得支持
Twitch负责人Dan Clancy表示，他预计《GTA6》今年11月发售时会掀起巨大热潮，其他游戏公司选择像躲瘟疫一样避开这一档期是有道理的。不过他也预计，当《GTA Online 2》（或者《GTA6》的多人模式最终也可能不叫这个）在明年推出时，《GTA6》还会继续吸走整个互联网的注意力。
Clancy在接受彭博社采访时表示，他已经和Rockstar Games聊过这家开发商接下来的计划。Clancy表示：「我们花了很多时间和Rockstar讨论他们的计划，同时也在帮助他们思考，应该如何与我们的内容创作者进行互动。你会看到《GTA6》带来一波巨大的增长，但等到他们明年推出多人模式时，还会有一波更大的增长。」
Rockstar目前还没有公布《GTA6》多人部分会在什么时候推出，甚至还没有正式确认会推出《GTA Online 2》，尽管大家都知道这个项目正在开发中。外界一直在激烈猜测它的发售时间，或者更准确地说，Rockstar会在《GTA6》11月发售后等多久才把它推出。2027年初？年中？还是年末？无论如何，明年看来基本是板上钉钉了。 还有更多相关内容 Spotify投放广告牌，疑似预告《GTA6》合作
那么，《GTA Online 2》会不会让现有的《GTA Online》变得多余？未必。去年，Rockstar母公司Take-Two的负责人Strauss Zelnick曾提到过《NBA 2K Online》的例子。这是一款面向亚洲市场、以在线玩法为主的免费篮球游戏，基于2K Sports大获成功的篮球系列打造。《NBA 2K Online》早在2012年就已经推出，之后2K Sports又在2017年推出了《NBA 2K Online 2》。两款游戏曾长期同时运营，因此第一作的玩家可以继续游玩和投入时间金钱，而不用担心自己会被抛下。
Zelnick告诉IGN：「我只能从理论层面来谈，因为在某个项目还没有正式公布之前，我不会针对具体项目发表评论。不过通常来说，只要消费者还在参与这些产品，我们就会继续支持。举个例子，我们在中国推出了《NBA 2K Online》，如果我没记错的话，最早是在2012年。然后我们又在2017年于中国推出了《NBA 2K Online 2》，如果我没记错的话。我们并没有关闭第一代Online。两款游戏现在都还在市场上，也都还在服务玩家、保持运营，而且我们拥有非常庞大的用户群体。所以我们已经证明，只要社区还愿意继续参与，我们就愿意继续支持旧作品。」
最后这句话尤其重要。它暗示即便《GTA Online 2》真的推出，也不一定意味着《GTA Online》会被彻底放弃。按照Zelnick这里的说法，只要还有人继续玩《GTA Online》，Rockstar就会继续提供支持。而且别忘了，《GTA6》首发只会登陆PS5和XBOX Series。PC玩家目前只有两个选择：加入主机阵营，或者继续在PC上玩《GTA5》和《GTA Online》。

title: Bungie否认将《命运》和《失落星船：马拉松》合并为同一IP的传闻
text:
相关文章: 《失落星船：马拉松》将下次大型更新延期至12月
在外界持续质疑《命运》和《失落星船：马拉松》两个系列未来走向之际，Bungie出面否认了有关其计划将两个IP合并的传闻。
这则本周在网上流传的消息称，Bungie正在测试把《失落星船：马拉松》和《命运》重新整合成一个单一IP。不过，《失落星船：马拉松》创意总监Julia Nardin表示，这并不属实。
Nardin在X上发文称：「作为一个同时参与过《命运》和《失落星船：马拉松》开发的人，我可以确认，所谓我们要合并这两个IP的『泄露消息』是假的。它们确实共享很多相同的Bungie DNA，但就像兄弟姐妹一样，它们也都是各自独立的存在。请不要相信你在网上看到的所有东西。」
当然，过去一段时间对于Bungie、《命运》和《失落星船：马拉松》来说都相当动荡。《失落星船：马拉松》最初是一款极度硬核的撤离射击游戏，但由于玩家数量表现不佳，Bungie之后一直在对它进行调整，让其玩法变得更接近《命运》。 还有更多相关内容 《失落星船：马拉松》「军械盗劫」限时活动预告
与此同时，Bungie停止了《命运2》的开发工作，把重心转向《失落星船：马拉松》，这一决定也惹恼了《命运》粉丝。在Bungie母公司索尼的直播中，大量观众不断呼吁Bungie回归《命运》的世界，不论是继续开发《命运2》，还是制作《命运3》。
本周，Bungie宣布《失落星船：马拉松》将放弃赛季制内容，转而重点发展PvE，同时还大幅延期了下一次大型更新。原定于9月22日推出的更新，现在将延期至12月8日。另一项大型更新则计划于明年3月推出。10月6日，《失落星船：马拉松》还会先迎来一次规模较小的更新，重置玩家进度和游戏内经济系统，为后续大改做准备。
Bungie随后又在社交媒体上作出澄清，表示12月和明年3月的更新都将免费提供，并非付费DLC。工作室表示：「如果你已经拥有《失落星船：马拉松》，那么12月和3月的更新都可以免费获得，不需要额外付费。这其中也包括新的区域、武器以及Runner等玩法内容。」
这也引出了一个问题：为什么Bungie需要专门作出这样的澄清？一些人认为，这可能暗示《失落星船：马拉松》未来会转向由付费资料片支持的免费游玩模式，因此这些更新不应该被误认为是资料片级别的内容。不过，Bungie目前并没有公布任何《失落星船：马拉松》资料片。也有可能，Bungie计划为《失落星船：马拉松》推出不同版本，其中部分版本需要付费，同时与免费版本并存。这些不同版本或许会提供不同层级的内容，让玩家自行选择。
而这一切背后始终存在的一个问题，当然就是索尼是否还会继续坚定支持《失落星船：马拉松》。索尼此前曾公开为这款游戏站台，但部分粉丝仍然担心它的未来。Steam同时在线人数当然不能完整反映一款多平台游戏的整体表现，但值得注意的是，《失落星船：马拉松》目前在Valve平台过去24小时内的同时在线峰值为2464人，相比游戏今年3月发售时创下的7.7万人历史峰值已经明显下降。

title: BBC已启动《神秘博士》新制作团队招标
text:
相关文章: 《神秘博士》前编剧：剧集回归计划将不了了之
《神秘博士》粉丝至少要等到2028年或2029年，才能看到BBC这部旗舰科幻剧集回归。
这一消息来自BBC公布的官方文件。目前，BBC已经开始寻找一支全新的制作团队，接手这个长寿系列。
正如此前宣布的那样，BBC正在启动一项「招标」流程，接受不同制作公司的方案，由此选出接手该系列并制作新剧集的团队。从今天开始，这一流程已经正式启动，BBC也公布了自己对剧集未来的预期，以及任何制作团队都必须满足的条件。
其中最值得关注的一点，是BBC明确表示，希望《神秘博士》能够在2028/29年播出新剧集——虽然距离现在还有好几年，但这个时间表依然显得有些激进。与此同时，BBC也明显保持着谨慎态度，因为此次招标只针对一季内容，是否续订第二季将「由BBC自行决定」。
这种情况发生在《神秘博士》最近一个时代以灾难性的方式结束之后。此前，迪士尼选择不再续签联合出资协议，随后主演Ncuti Gatwa也在最近一季经过重拍的结局中离开。原本计划用于收束剧集剩余故事线的安排也宣告失败，剧集主管Russell T. Davies此前宣布的一部圣诞特别篇，后来也被确认取消。 还有更多相关内容 《神秘博士》或将停播长达五年
毫不意外的是，BBC表示仍希望继续把《神秘博士》制作成多集剧集（也就是说，目前还不会改成《神秘博士》电影）。再具体来看，BBC表示，只会考虑那些至少符合Ofcom三项地区制作标准中两项的投标方案。这套标准旨在确保BBC的节目制作能够覆盖并代表英国不同地区，主要包括三项要求：制作项目在英国境内、但大伦敦地区以外设有实际运营基地；至少70%的制作预算在该地区支出；以及至少50%的幕后工作人员来自或常驻该地区。
中还提到需要制作特别篇，这强烈暗示BBC希望恢复该系列固定的圣诞特别篇档期。BBC还特别表示，自己「更倾向于符合威尔士地区标准的方案」，这也反映出过去几十年里，《神秘博士》的制作基地以及文化归属一直与威尔士关系密切。最后，制作公司提交投标方案的截止日期是10月1日——距离现在已经不远了。
不过话虽如此，这一流程的第一阶段只需要提交一份三页的方案文件，其中包括对剧集的简短创作构想，以及特别篇的相关想法。入围的投标方随后会进入下一阶段，整个流程总计大约会持续六个月。
BBC公布的指导方针还表示，新剧必须包含一名同伴角色，用来「作为观众进入故事的切入点，同时也要挑战、支持并影响博士」。既有反派角色也可以继续使用，不过BBC表示，希望新剧「不要过度依赖现有《神秘博士》设定」。至于一季的叙事结构，BBC没有表达明确偏好，既可以采用贯穿整季的长篇故事线，也可以制作「一周一怪」形式的独立单集。
BBC给出的时间表显示，与制作公司的面谈将在2027年1月底前进行，而BBC会在3月作出最终决定。虽然目前已经有多家制作公司表达了兴趣，但外界普遍认为，最有希望赢得招标的是BBC自己的商业部门BBC Studios。至少从今天公布的文件来看，如果是一家美国公司参与竞标，整个流程可能会复杂得多。
如果一切顺利，并且BBC能在明年3月前确定制作公司，那么距离2028年播出，还剩下略多于18个月的时间，用来完成剧本创作、选角和拍摄——这还没有算后期制作所需的时间。这么看来时间安排还是非常紧张的。

title: 为在今秋发售潮中提高竞争力，《不朽遗志》定价40美元
text:
相关文章: 《不朽遗志》剧情预告 | gamescom 2026
备受期待的第一人称动作魂系游戏《不朽遗志》已确认售价为40美元。发行商表示，之所以定下这个价格，是因为今年秋季在《GTA6》带动下，大作发售档期异常拥挤。
发行商Lyrical Games在一份声明中表示：「过去一年里，我们围绕《不朽遗志》的定价进行了很多讨论。我们相信，这款游戏在品质、完成度以及长达20小时的剧情内容方面，都有能力与许多全价游戏（70美元游戏）正面竞争。但今年秋季的游戏实在太多了，玩家的时间和金钱都面临着非常激烈的争夺。」
《不朽遗志》此前已经从9月24日延期至10月13日，以避开Remedy的《控制：共振》和科乐美的《寂静岭：Townfall》等作品，但一个月后《GTA6》也即将发售。发行商希望，通过比部分竞争对手更低的定价，让《不朽遗志》更加显眼，不过这样做也存在一个风险：部分玩家可能会因此认为这款游戏的品质不如那些高价作品。 还有更多相关内容 《不朽遗志》开发者专访：你玩过魔改版拿破仑魂游吗？| IGN 中国
在接受The Game Business采访时，Lyrical Games负责人Blake Rochkind进一步解释了这一决定，并承认定价问题是「我们真正纠结了很久的事情」。他说：「我最大的担忧，是这个价格会向玩家传递错误的信息。但我们作出这个决定，恰恰是出于信心。客观来说，今年秋季可能是这个行业历史上最疯狂的发售季，而我们恰好是少数几款在这段时间推出的全新IP之一。不仅11月有《GTA》这座大山压在那里，现在还有《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版、《控制：共振》几周后发售、《寂静岭：Townfall》《影之刃零》《战争机器》《使命召唤》……受开发进度影响，我们手里拿到的牌就是这样：今年秋季，我们是少数几款发售的全新IP之一。我们对《不朽遗志》相当有信心。但归根结底，我们最不应该做的，就是不敢押上筹码，不敢明确地说：『我们希望这是一款你在购买其他优秀游戏时，也可以一起买下的游戏。』」
他这里的意思是，《不朽遗志》可以成为玩家在购买另一款、可能价格更高的游戏之外，再顺手买下的一款作品，而40美元的定价会让这个决定变得更容易。比如，有人本来就计划购买《GTA6》，其最低售价也达到80美元，但在那之前的几周里，他们或许也不介意花一半的价格买下《不朽遗志》来玩。
又或者，玩家会同时购买《控制：共振》和《不朽遗志》，也可能是其他任何组合。Rochkind表示：「采用这个价格，能帮助我们成为一款『以及』型游戏。」值得注意的是，《不朽遗志》也将在首发当天加入XBOX Game Pass，不过Rochkind坚持表示，这与游戏的定价决定无关。
《不朽遗志》由《幽灵行者》的开发团队打造，是一款第一人称魂系游戏。玩家将扮演一名曾效力于拿破仑军队的士兵，从死亡中苏醒，然后在与蹒跚尸群和狂暴怪物的战斗中一次又一次死去。

title: 报道称环球影业可能放弃发行《马斯克》纪录片
text:
据报道，尽管一部埃隆·马斯克的纪录片近期在多个电影节上获得高度评价，环球影业仍在重新考虑是否发行该片。
这部名为《马斯克》的纪录片片长达4小时，中间设有10分钟休息时间，由高产纪录片导演Alex Gibney执导。Gibney采访到了多名与这位Grok所有者私生活关系密切的人士，以及一些对其政治影响力发表评论的人。
虽然这样一部聚焦世界首富、信息量十足的纪录片很可能会吸引大量观众进影院，但《好莱坞报道》称，环球影业现在很可能会放弃对影片进行全面发行。
环球影业早在2023年就花费数百万美元买下《马斯克》的发行权，当时这位如今已成为万亿富豪的马斯克还没有完全倒向总统唐纳德·特朗普一边。不过据报道，如今环球对于发行这部影片已经产生犹豫，目前最可能的结果是，影片版权将被退还给Gibney，由他另寻买家。
在马斯克本人拥有的X平台上，前《华尔街日报》和NBC News记者Matt Rivera发帖回顾了自己在威尼斯电影节观看这部纪录片的经历。影片当时获得了长达5分钟的掌声，他还列出了片中多项引人关注的内容。其中包括马斯克前伴侣Ashley St. Clair提出的一项说法：这位万亿富豪由于「太空中的激光」，在2024年大选结果正式公布前数小时就已经知道了结果。影片还收录了马斯克对于《华尔街日报》有关其涉嫌吸毒报道的反应，以及St. Clair所称的一份保密协议。她表示，在生下马斯克已知14个孩子中的一个之后，自己曾被要求签署这份协议。
此前，「太空中的激光」这一说法已经引起马斯克律师Alex Spiro的注意。他似乎试图澄清，这个说法并没有其他含义，只是在指Starlink卫星在太空中进行通信的方式。NPR报道称，Spiro曾致信Gibney以及Jigsaw Productions的影片制作团队，表示制片方已经被正式「告知」相关情况。Spiro写道：「Starlink与计票工作没有任何关系。2024年11月，多个州的选举官员、独立网络安全研究人员以及事实核查机构都已经公开驳斥了Starlink操纵选票的说法，此后也没有出现任何新证据让这一说法重新成立。Starlink卫星通过激光星间链路进行通信，这就是『太空中的激光』所描述的内容。因此，在影片上映前，你们已经被明确告知，这种暗示是错误的，反驳这一说法的材料也是公开可查的，而你们却选择不去听取其他解释。」
对此，Jigsaw表示，依据美国宪法第一修正案，公司有权「对有权势的公众人物进行公开讨论和基于事实的审视」，并称这项权利「应该得到所有美国人的认可和捍卫，其中也包括埃隆·马斯克的同事。毕竟，马斯克一直宣称自己是『言论自由绝对主义者』」。
纪录片中还出现了马斯克的其他前伴侣和家人，不过马斯克本人（或许并不令人意外）拒绝参与拍摄。Rivera写道，影片因此使用CGI替身来重现马斯克过去的公开言论，作为对影片主题的一种「字面化呈现」——「一个制造自己现实的人」。
马斯克最近连续在社交媒体上发文评论这部影片，称其是一部「没打中的攻击性作品」、一部「虚假的电影」，而且还「很无聊」。马斯克和Spiro其实都没有看过这部影片。双方围绕Gibney拒绝与他们讨论影片内容一事发生冲突，而Gibney则表示，马斯克此前拒绝参与拍摄和接受采访。
Rivera在看完电影后总结道：「这并不是马斯克所说的那种恶意攻击。有些时候，它甚至为了保持公平而显得过于谨慎。但它确实刺破了围绕马斯克建立起来的神话，有些故事甚至会讲两遍，以揭示其中的矛盾，同时也提出一些没有答案的问题：为什么会有这么多孩子？他拿这么多数据到底在做什么？」
如果环球影业最终放弃《马斯克》，这也不会是近期首个发行商放弃一部可能让人看得不太舒服的纪录片案例。此前，亚马逊曾放弃Sam Altman的纪录片《Artificial》，而就在几天前，亚马逊才刚刚与Altman旗下公司OpenAI签下一份价值500亿美元的协议。马斯克同样出现在那部纪录片中，该片目前将改由独立发行商Neon发行。
《好莱坞报道》还提到了《马斯克》流媒体发行目前的情况。HBO已经为其流媒体版权付费，而且在拍摄期间影片需要追加预算时，HBO还进一步提供过资金。HBO未来很可能会归属于华纳兄弟，而这笔交易由CEO David Ellison及其亿万富豪父亲Larry Ellison支持。据报道，《马斯克》中对Larry Ellison的呈现并不正面——因此，这部纪录片的流媒体发行最终是否还能按计划推进，也值得关注。

title: 桑德森称不会接手续写《冰与火之歌》
text:
「乔治并不欠大家这些书……」——在IGN的一次独家采访中，美国幻想文学作家布兰登·桑德森解释了为什么即使有人邀请，他也会拒绝替乔治·R·R·马丁完成《冰与火之歌》系列，并呼吁粉丝给予马丁更多支持和耐心。
当被问到是否会考虑像当年接手《时光之轮》那样完成这个系列时，Sanderson表示：「恕我直言，我不是做这件事的合适人选——而且我想，我们两个人作品的大多数粉丝都会同意这一点。从某种意义上说，我整个创作生涯都是对《冰与火之歌》的一种回应。就像《冰与火之歌》本身，也是对1990年代流行奇幻小说的一种回应，比如《时光之轮》。如果我真的答应，我当然会尽最大努力，按照粉丝希望和期待的方式去写。但我不会答应——因为还有比我自然得多、更适合这个项目的人选。如果乔治真的决定走这条路，他也应该找一个像我当年与《时光之轮》那样，真正适合他所创造世界的人。话虽如此，我并不觉得乔治想这么做，所以我们还是支持他按照自己能够做到的速度，把这些书写出来吧。」
这也与乔治·R·R·马丁今年自己的说法一致。他表示，目前并没有让其他人接手的计划。相反，如果他无法完成，那么《冰与火之歌》这个系列就只是「不会写完」。
这位77岁的作家最近也承认，自己一直没有提供这个著名系列的最新进展，并形容今年到目前为止「至少可以说，压力很大」。马丁在一篇题为「迟到总比不到好」的文章中写道：「发生了太多事情，让人有些喘不过气。有些是很棒的事情、令人兴奋的事情。梦想正在成真。但也有噩梦。我失去了一些朋友。和悲伤与抑郁作斗争。而最糟糕的事情可能还没有到来。」马丁继续说道：「去年9月我已经77岁了，我可以告诉你，变老一点也不好玩。不过，也确实有过一些非常美好的时光。」
在与IGN交谈时，桑德森也谈到了马丁最近面临的心理健康挑战：「我恳请大家在讨论这件事时，记得他首先是一个人。乔治·R·R·马丁是我们这个类型最伟大的作者之一，而我每一次和他接触，他都对我非常友善——甚至在我还默默无闻的时候也是如此。他确实可以说是奇幻文学领域德高望重的前辈，也一直做了大量工作去扶持新人、帮助整个社区，并在别人需要时提供建议和支持。」
桑德森接着表示：「与此同时，写作也可能是一份非常孤独的职业，而我们都知道，有时候一本书就是怎么都写不顺。我很幸运，因为我遇到这种情况时，通常都是一些支线项目，我可以直接放弃，而不会给自己的职业生涯带来太大影响。真正能够让《冰与火之歌》最终完成的，只有我们的支持、耐心，以及努力去记住书籍为什么如此特别：它们是如今极少数仍然主要由单独一个人创作出来的大众艺术形式之一。」
马丁此前也多次表达过自己对健康问题被反复拿到漫展座谈会上讨论的不满，并表示自己知道网上一直有人围绕他的年龄和健康状况进行猜测：「他们会说，『他骗了我们，他很快就要死了，你看看他都多大了。』我真的不需要听这些鬼话。」马丁在提到一名粉丝提出的问题时说道，「没人需要听这种鬼话。」
在谈到马丁时，桑德森也继续反对「作家欠读者一个完整结局」这种说法：「乔治并不欠大家这些书，因为这种承诺他实际上根本做不了——我们谁都做不了。我没法保证自己一定能写完《飓光志》，因为谁知道我会不会明天突然得病。从这个意义上说，我实际上根本没有能力对未来作出这种保证，任何人都一样。话虽如此，我确实认为，当我们这些作者开始创作一个系列时，也是在和读者之间建立一种契约——而这种契约确实意味着我们要承担一定责任。比如承诺会继续做这个项目，给予它应有的重视，尽最大努力及时把书写出来。但这终究是一门艺术。和其他人一样，我偶尔也会拿《冰与火之歌》一直没有结局这件事开玩笑。不过我自己也半斤八两，因为我也有一本书《The Rithmatist》，我答应粉丝会写续集，而大家等这本续集的时间，已经和等乔治下一卷差不多一样久了。一直没能交出这本书，我自己也非常难受，但艺术创作这个过程有时候就是很难预测。」
桑德森最后表示：「不管怎么说，我不知道乔治是不是真的欠任何人这些书，但他确实欠大家的是认真、持续地努力去完成它们。这听起来可能只是在抠字眼，但我是个作家，这就是我们的工作。不过，判断乔治到底有没有付出这种努力，并不是我的工作。我的直觉告诉我，他确实付出了——而我们现在之所以会处在这种局面，其实说明了一个我们作者每天都必须面对、但其他人也需要接受的残酷现实。从外面看，写书可能像是一门手艺，但实际上它是一门艺术，更像创作音乐……而有时候，你的脑海中就是会突然失去那段旋律。而你只能寄希望于它不会永远消失。」

title: 《GTA Online》将在《GTA6》发售后继续获得支持
text:
相关文章: Twitch负责人称厂商避开《GTA6》是「正确之举」
Rockstar Games计划在《GTA6》发售后继续支持《GTA Online》，母公司Take-Two已经对此作出确认。
在最近的一次股东大会上，Take-Two表示：「《GTA6》发售之后，以及更长远的未来，我们都会继续支持《GTA Online》。」
Rockstar此前已经确认，《GTA6》首发时将只有单人模式，因此游戏于11月推出时不会包含多人模式。也就是说，如果你还想体验《GTA》的线上玩法，就只能继续回到现有版本的《GTA Online》。 还有更多相关内容 Spotify投放广告牌，疑似预告《GTA6》合作
之后大概还会推出另一个版本的《GTA Online》，但现在越来越不清楚它究竟会以什么形式、又会在什么时候推出。它会在之后追加到《GTA6》中吗？还是会作为一款独立游戏推出，需要玩家另外购买？不过，Twitch负责人Dan Clancy确信，《GTA6》的多人模式会在2027年推出。他最近接受彭博社采访时表示，自己已经和Rockstar讨论过开发团队接下来的计划。Clancy表示：「我们花了很多时间和Rockstar讨论他们的计划，同时也帮助他们思考应该如何与我们的内容创作者互动。你会看到《GTA6》带来一波非常大的增长，但等到他们明年推出多人模式时，还会有一波更大的增长。」
与此同时，在这次股东大会上，Take-Two负责人Strauss Zelnick还回应了一个问题：主机供应短缺，尤其是PS5 Pro的供应问题，是否影响了公司在PC平台上的计划。Zelnick没有透露太多细节，他回答道：「总体来说，随着时间推移，公司的策略一直都是，在任何拥有足够规模受众的平台上推出游戏。但情况并不总是如此，当然，如果某个平台已经不再具备可行性，我们也可能调整这一策略。另外我还想指出，随着时间推移，PC平台对我们公司正变得越来越重要。」
Zelnick此前曾表示，Rockstar历来都是先在主机平台推出游戏，这也暗示《GTA6》的PC版可能会在之后推出。至于究竟要等多久，目前还不清楚，不过《GTA5》至今仍然是PC平台上一款极其热门的游戏。
Rockstar Games前制作人John Ricchio今年早些时候接受采访时表示，Rockstar持续选择不在首发时推出PC版，并不是出于贪婪。相反，这是因为Rockstar希望先针对主机进行优化，然后再把游戏扩展到PC版本。Ricchio表示：「先在限制条件下进行开发，然后再向上扩展，永远是更好的方式。因为缩减要比扩展困难得多。要让一款游戏达到理想性能，远比你直接说『哦，我们现在有更多余量了？很好，那我们可以少做一点优化，或者让画面变得更漂亮』要困难得多。」
那么，PC版有没有可能和下一版《GTA Online》一起推出？如果两者之间确实存在相当长的时间差，那看起来也并非完全不可能。无论如何，可以看出Rockstar正在投入大量精力，努力为《GTA6》打造尽可能出色的单人游戏体验，而不愿为了其他部分作出妥协，即使这意味新的《GTA Online》可能要再等一段时间了。

title: 动视称《使命召唤：现代战争4》为「史诗终章」
text:
相关文章: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》战役模式宣传视频 | TGS 2026
《使命召唤：现代战争4》目前被宣传为「史诗终章」，这似乎意味着该系列一个时代即将结束。
在《使命召唤：现代战争4》最新预告片的社交媒体文案中，动视表示，这款游戏将成为《现代战争》传奇的「史诗终章」。目前还不清楚，这是否意味着当前《现代战争》宇宙会就此永久结束，还是仅仅代表自2019年重启版《现代战争》开始的这条持续剧情线将告一段落。
虽然这很可能只是一句营销宣传语，但这个说法出现的时机颇为耐人寻味。本周早些时候，Treyarch设计总监Kevin Drew表示，工作室已经准备好「做点新的东西，做出一些此前从来没人体验过的东西」。这番话正值Treyarch连续两年推出《黑色行动》作品后准备告别该系列之际，而最近一作也被不少人认为是这个系列一次表现平平的失误。这些评论让粉丝开始猜测，《黑色行动》系列或许也将结束，或者至少会暂时休息一段时间，让Treyarch有机会制作近20年来首个全新的《使命召唤》子系列。
一些粉丝已经开始向当前这一代《现代战争》系列告别。一名粉丝在《使命召唤》Reddit社区发帖调侃道：「再重启一次吧。」另一名粉丝则建议：「他们应该做《使命召唤：幽灵2》或者《无限战争2》，这两作的战役其实都被低估了。」当然，他到底是不是在开玩笑就不好说了。
如果《现代战争》和《黑色行动》真的都要告一段落，那么这将是自2010年《黑色行动》诞生以来，《使命召唤》系列首次在轮换阵容中没有至少一个现有子系列继续存在。虽然我们目前还不知道Sledgehammer正在开发什么，但那很可能也是一个全新的子系列，因为《高级战争》以及该工作室之后制作的几款二战题材作品都没能真正形成持续热度。 还有更多相关内容 Switch 2版《使命召唤：现代战争4》Beta测试实机演示
最初的《现代战争》系列早在2011年就以三部曲形式完结。当时团队也曾讨论过制作第四部，但相关想法并没有推进太远，最终他们选择另起炉灶，制作了《使命召唤：幽灵》。在《幽灵》以及Infinity Ward之后推出的《无限战争》都没能让粉丝满意后，工作室又回到了最熟悉的牌面，重启了《现代战争》。2019年的这部作品普遍被认为帮助《使命召唤》摆脱了持续多年的低谷，当时粉丝对这个系列的信心正在逐渐流失。它还催生了《战区》，这款极受欢迎的大逃杀模式自推出以来也一直帮助支撑整个系列。
在2026年XBOX东京电玩展直播中，动视确认《死亡搁浅》主演Mads Mikkelsen将在《使命召唤：现代战争4》中饰演一名主要反派。游戏将于10月23日登陆PC和主机平台，但不会首发加入XBOX Game Pass。

title: 《归零巡礼：亡谍镇魂曲 导演剪辑版》宣传视频
text:
PS5版将于11月3日发售

title: 前顽皮狗总监称「如今的3A游戏很无聊」
text:
相关文章: 《战神》真人剧确认巴蒂斯塔接演奎托斯
曾担任《最后生还者》和多部《神秘海域》游戏总监的Bruce Straley认为，如今的3A游戏很「无聊」。
在《Edge》杂志一篇讨论游戏行业现状的报道中，Straley谈到了如今的3A游戏市场。他表示，自己觉得这些大型商业作品很「无聊」，其中一个原因就是它们缺乏冒险精神。Straley以《战神：劳菲》为例，称这显然是一款投入了大量精力和技术才能制作出来的游戏，但在创新层面或许并没有特别突出的地方。 还有更多相关内容 《战神：劳菲》发售日预告
他说：「《战神：劳菲》，我看这款游戏的时候，每一个像素都让人惊叹。每一帧画面背后投入的工作量和技术水平……我自己也做过这种类型的游戏，但看到它的时候依然会被震撼。但当我真正去看你在游戏里具体做些什么时？我并不会感到兴奋。这不是在针对《战神》团队。只是从整个3A领域来看，感觉几乎没有什么机会能够加入新鲜、创新的想法。」
而其中颇具讽刺意味的一点是，Straley自己或许正是如今大量3A游戏的灵感来源之一。《神秘海域》和《最后生还者》几乎为如今大量涌现的那种高度电影化的第三人称动作游戏建立了模板。这一点在PlayStation和《战神》身上尤其明显。2018年的《战神》软重启版就曾被玩家调侃，称它像是一部由奎托斯主演的《最后生还者》。
Straley于2017年离开Naughty Dog，当时《神秘海域4：盗贼末路》已经发售。他在《最后生还者2》的制作人员名单中获得了特别鸣谢，不过目前并不清楚他究竟为最终成品贡献了多少，因为这款游戏在没有他的情况下又经历了将近4年的开发。
Straley离开公司的原因，是高强度3A游戏开发过程让他经历了严重的职业倦怠。如今，Straley正在自己的工作室Wildflower Interactive开发规模更小的游戏。他在Wildflower旗下的首款作品《Coven of the Chicken Foot》于2025年TGA颁奖典礼上正式公布，看起来与他此前在Naughty Dog参与制作的作品有很大不同。目前这款游戏还没有公布发售日期。

title: 《孤岛惊魂》剧集新增5名演员
text:
迪士尼旗下的电视网络和影视内容品牌FX即将推出剧集《孤岛惊魂》，改编自育碧旗下热门第一人称射击游戏系列，目前正在为正式开拍继续扩充演员阵容。获得奥斯卡提名的詹妮弗·杰森·李（《冰血暴》-洛伦）和布莱丹·格里森（《哈利·波特》-疯眼汉穆迪）已经确认加盟。
詹妮弗·杰森·李和布莱丹·格里森
此外还有哈米什·林克莱特（《新闻编辑室》-杰瑞·丹塔纳）、萨姆·斯普卢尔（《七王国的骑士》-梅卡·坦格利安）以及詹米·德米特鲁。
哈米什·林克莱特和萨姆·斯普卢尔和詹米·德米特鲁
《孤岛惊魂》的剧集主创为诺亚·霍利和罗布·麦克。此前已经公布的演员还包括麦克、丽兹·卡潘以及史蒂夫·布西密。作为一部选集剧，《孤岛惊魂》每一季都会讲述不同的故事，采用不同的背景和演员阵容。该剧将在FX和Hulu播出，目前尚未公布上线日期。
游戏方面，《孤岛惊魂》系列已经沉寂了一段时间，目前最新一作仍是2021年的《孤岛惊魂6》。IGN当时认为这是一款很不错的作品，并给出了8分评价。

title: 《星球大战：银河赛车手》游戏前瞻
text:
星战竞速新生
《银河赛车手》最聪明之处，是用Roguelite循环重塑星战竞速，并以《火爆狂飙》式冲撞赋予赛道真正的危险感。它不只是怀旧续作，更可能成为星战游戏授权策略下的又一次惊喜。

title: 《西部拓荒纪》独家实机演示
text:
亲历一段关于淘金梦想、危险遭遇与寻找家人的西部故事
《西部拓荒纪（Wild West Pioneers）》是一款城市建造冒险游戏，你将带领一群拓荒者深入尚未开垦的西部边疆。建设并管理不断发展的聚落，建立完整的生产链，探索广袤世界，并亲历一段关于淘金梦想、危险遭遇与寻找家人的西部故事。游戏将于9月25日在PC平台开启抢先体验。

title: 10分，《火焰纹章 万缕千丝》评测
text:
剑指巅峰
《火焰纹章 万缕千丝》把战术战斗与经营管理真正融成了一体，四位主角各自独立又彼此交织的故事也不断带来新变化。更难得的是，即使流程超过百小时，新的挑战、系统和路线依然能持续制造惊喜。

title: Backrooms director and Portal superfan Kane Parsons spotted visiting Valve for the second time this year
text:
As reported by IGN and Gabe Follower on X , Backrooms director Kane Parsons shared an Instagram story from Valve's Bellevue, Washington headquarters on September 16. The director has previously said that Portal was extremely influential on his work , inspiring hopes for a Parsons-led adaptation or some other collaboration with the studio.
There's more circumstantial evidence in favor of this being more than just a friendly visit: Parsons previously told The New York Times in May that making a Portal feature film would be his "dream." What's more, this isn't the first time Parsons has been seen at Valve HQ. His Instagram story commemorating a visit in June has been preserved by user eugen3 on the Valve subreddit .
Those are encouraging signs that we could have a Portal movie from a guy who'd do a great job on it to look forward to, but there are some caveats. Parsons also told the NYT in May that he doesn't want to move on from Backrooms until it reaches some kind of conclusion, and he is already engaged to direct a sequel for A24.
There is also the matter of J.J. Abrams' seemingly-abandoned Portal movie project. He last spoke about it on the record in 2021, but there could be some standing contracts or agreements to consider.
I find I'm not particularly excited about a videogame adaptation unless the right director's involved, but there's been a lot of that going around recently. Zach Cregger's Resident Evil is looking like a slam dunk , even if some people are grumpy it's not about Leon Kennedy, and I find myself increasingly excited for Alex "The Guy Who Wrote Dredd" Garland's upcoming Elden Ring movie.
Parsons has already shown himself to be a master of the sort of abandoned corporate surrealism that defined Portal⁠, and his passion for the subject matter would also be cause for excitement. Gaming also runs in Parsons' family: His father, Michael Parsons, was a longtime technical artist at Telltale during its legendary 2010s hot streak.

title: Epic boss Tim Sweeney says the EU's social media ban for under-13s 'would be terrible for the next generation of humanity'
text:
Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney says the European Union's plan to restrict social media use by children, including a complete ban for anyone under the age of 13, is "terrible for the next generation of humanity" because of the impact it will have on the growth of creativity and expression.
Announced today, the EU KIDS Act —"Keeping Internet Digital Spaces Accountable and Trustworthy," because overwrought acronyms for serious legislation isn't a uniquely American phenomenon—imposes a blanket ban on social media accounts for anyone under the age of 13, although "specially-designed child-friendly video-sharing services" can be established via their parents' or guardian's accounts.
From the ages of 13 to 15, accounts can be set up under the supervision of guardians, although they should have "limited features and screen time." From 15 up, minors can set up their own "autonomous accounts" without parental consent, although "parental guidance remains essential during this stage."
The goal of the new regulations is to effect a "gradual approach" to social media use—the digital equivalent of teaching kids to swim before throwing them into the lake. Notably, the KIDS Act covers not just traditional social media platforms—Instagram, TikTok, and the like—but also "video-sharing platforms, online games, AI chatbots or companions," plus app stores and operating systems. Some services, like online encyclopedias, educational platforms, and digital news outlets, would be exempt.
"Today, our children are engaging with the most sophisticated technologies ever created. Technology that was never created with their wellbeing in mind," EU president Ursula von der Leyen said in a statement . "Our KIDS Act is reversing the burden of proof—it is for platforms to show they are safe by design. And we put parents back in the driving seat, giving them the tools to help their children navigate a safer online world."
Sweeney takes a different view of the situation, however. "This would be terrible for the next generation of humanity," the Epic chief said on X , a day prior to the act's official announcement. "The apps and games of today are the paintbrushes and tree forts of yesterday. Fortnite has Creative Mode, Roblox has Roblox studio, and being a digital creator is in everyone's reach, till politicians take it away."
(Image credit: Tim Sweeney (Twitter)) It's fair to say that it would not be great news for Epic if the EU suddenly made it a whole lot harder for kids under 15 to play Fortnite, and without wanting to sound like an 'in my day we drank straight from the hose!' guy, I would point out that paintbrushes and tree forts are still readily available. It's not as if pre-teens will be reduced to cave painting and hitting each other with rocks if they're suddenly no longer able to generate content for billionaires.
Even so, I find myself on board with Sweeney's broader stance— this isn't a great idea —not out of concerns that it will dull the creative instincts of the next generation, but simply because it's a potential security and privacy nightmare that's difficult to enforce and may or may not achieve its stated goals anyway.
And as other PC Gamer writers have previously pointed out , the impact of social media on young minds is only part of the problem, and arguably a relatively minor part: It also bakes the brains of adults with startling efficiency.
The EU KIDS Act is not a done deal. The proposed regulation has been submitted to the European Parliament and Council, and from there will enter the legislative process required for approval. Given the recent enactment of social media bans for kids and online age verification requirements in Australia , the UK , and some US states , though, and "the clear demand for urgent and comprehensive action" expressed by the EU, I expect it will be soon enough.

title: I have officially made Grand Theft Auto 5 good by turning it into a golf sim
text:
Los Santos Customs
I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
I grew up by a dry riverbed. This was, on the whole, positive, because what a big empty riverbed is good for is setting things on fire, firing air rifles, and walloping golf balls into orbit. Some say they never stopped travelling. They're still out there, somewhere, in the space between the stars.
The reason Grand Theft Auto 5 is worse than a riverbed is that you can't do that last thing. Or, well, you can , but only at officially designated golf courses, which are prisons for the soul. I have now fixed this omission. I installed Street Golf , which lets you play golf, but in the street.
Much like the previous two mods I've bolted onto GTA 5's sagging frame ( LifeInvader Business Mod and Become A Celebrity ), I was immediately impressed by how much of the mod there is. This is no ramshackle creation—the possibility of equipping a golf club and whacking some balls in the street—but comes with a suite of tweakable menus, golf stats, and potent balltypes . Normal balls? Yes. Fire balls? Absolutely. Detonating balls? Very much so. And super balls, which you can set to travel about 200x further than any other ball in your arsenal.
Being as I am now accompanied everywhere by a bodyguard, who is instantly replaced by an almost-identical bodyguard whenever he happens to get pancaked by a flying car or assassinated by a squad of mercenaries, I opted to use him as a kind of ambulatory mini-golf windmill.
My shots were angled towards him, alternately sending him cartwheeling hilariously down the street, sending him cartwheeling even further down the street (super ball, you see), or setting him on fire. The detonating balls never quite worked. The mod procced some sort of achievement when I successfully nailed him in the dome with a maximum-power shot.
(Image credit: Rockstar) It's a pleasant distraction. Whenever the travails of my life in Los Santos get too much I can, at any moment, drop into Golf Mode. Would that real life were the same way.

title: Valheim devs finally get around to reading 5 years of player feedback, let you remap dodge key
text:
When battling tree-swinging trolls, ice-spitting dragons, and fire-breathing skeletal demigods, it's hard to think of a skill more important than dodging. A shield or a weapon held up defensively can help, sure, but escaping deadly attacks in Valheim is often down to how quickly you can tuck and roll.
Which makes it a bit curious that over the past five years of early access, you couldn't redbind the dodge skill to a single key or button press. If you want to dodge on keyboard, you have to hold the block button (mouse 2) and press jump (space bar) and pick a direction (WASD). On controller, it's a stick + button combo. No single tap for a deeply important maneuver has been available for the past five years.
Until today! Those busy Valhiem devs finally took a peek at player feedback and noticed the request people have been making constantly for the past five years, seven months, 15 days, 17 hours, and 22 minutes: You have now been granted the ability to remap your dodge key to an alternate—no doubt single-tap—configuration.
Better late than never?
That's not the only key rebinding option that's been added. You can rebind items on the radial wheel and hotbar, too. A much newer request, to disable the intro cinematic (which only appeared with Valheim 1.0 last week), has also been granted. There are also some bug fixes, notably more tinkering with the Valheim cheat -flagging feature that was mislabeling some players and resources as cheats.
Have a look at the full patch notes below, and good luck trying to unlearn the muscle memory you've developed for dodging with three different keys over the past five years or so. One note: the patch, devs say, "will require a few days to get uploaded to all platforms." I've checked and it's live on PC now, however.
Quality of Life :
Added several new keybinding options to the keyboard (Alternate dodge key, hotbar rebinding (on top of 1-8), support for rebinding radial wheel, support for removing keybinds)
Added accessibility setting to be able to toggle blocking
Add toggle to Gameplay settings to skip the intro cinematic on startup
When attacking, the player’s rotation now also snaps towards the intended attack direction when the “attack towards look direction” option is enabled, not just when it’s disabled.
Swapped Motion Sensor and Sheath keybinds on gamepad, returning Sheath to its original keybind. Motion Sensor can now be activated with the alt-key + Sheath button instead.
Optimizations :
Improved GPU performance when tessellation is disabled by eliminating unnecessary GPU overhead in this case.
Heightmap shadows are now calculated more accurately and at a lower performance cost.
Optimized particle systems in the main menu to reduce overdraw.
Multiple GPU performance improvements on Switch 2.
Bugs & Issues :
PlayerBase effect on some build pieces has been increased to block enemies more
Fixed inaccuracies in stick input pre-processing that made it heavily weighted towards axis-aligned movement and 30% too slow diagonally.
Jotun puffs and Magecaps no longer respawn.
Fix for player characters sometimes mistakenly being marked as temporary cheaters, leading to items dropped by monsters they kill being incorrectly marked as having a cheated origin.
Cheated stackable items no longer stack with regular items, preventing uncheated stacks from being “corrupted” into a cheated state.
Persistent Events devcommand (“pevents”) is now actually behind the devcommands toggle and not available in the console by default.
Fixed errors when using the grappling hook’s secondary attack on creatures.
Fixed various issues with Ashlands water (VFX, water damage not stopping)
Fixed a bug where characters didn’t save correctly when manually pressing Save while playing on a server hosted by someone else.
Disabled biomedata caching, fixing a bug where the cache could end up in an invalid state, making it impossible to join remote servers.
Fixed Deep North battleaxes tool tier, can now cut all the trees.
Made placeable boulders persist, only placeable on the ground, break if the ground they’re standing on goes away, and give ground-level support.
Updated Ballista to make it accept all new trophies (All Deep North enemies + Bjorn + Vile)
Timberwood build pieces no longer incorrectly show up in earlier biome locations
Fixed various crashes/errors that could happen in rare circumstances
Fixed a bug where Helmet of the Protector was craftable directly via the Black Forge
Fixed a bug where terrain modifications by players or monsters could lead to performance and portal issues in multiplayer, such as performance and portaling issues, terrain seams, and terrain modifications becoming undone
Updated Deep North and Winding Tunnels music for better balance and to remove some clicks when looping.
Now plays the correct music in Mörkhalla.
Better mixing of location music in the Deep North.
Tweaked Seal and Baby Seal colliders to better match their bodies.
Fixed an issue where the “No time for snoozing” achievement could sometimes not be unlocked in multiplayer
Fixed an issue where The Homesteader and The Architect achievements could unlock repeatedly.
Nintendo Switch 2: The TV output no longer switches from 120 Hz to 60 Hz while the virtual keyboard is open or while in the home menu when using the balanced graphics preset and playing online multiplayer, which caused a black screen while entering and leaving these menus.
PlayStation®5: The TV output no longer switches from 120 Hz to 60 Hz while in the home menu when using the balanced graphics preset, which caused a black screen when entering and leaving this menu.
PlayStation®5: The “Stronger Together” achievement is now achievable.
Steam: Fixed a bug where Steam Cloud could get stuck in an invalid state if the game crashed while saving.

title: Can you name the game this game-within-a-game is from?
text:
I heard you like games, so I put a game-within-a-game so you can… game? I don't know, but I couldn't pretend like there wasn't an early 2000s joke in there.
More quizzes!
(Image credit: Future) Want to keep testing your knowledge of gaming trivia? We've got loads more PC Gamer quizzes , on everything from healthbars to weird currencies to absurd patch notes.
This week's quiz is all about fun little derailments. Think minigames, but games within games and not Mario Party-style collections. I'm talking things like Triple Triad—Final Fantasy 8's stellar card game that also made it into the MMO—it's the type of sidequest you access from within your main campaign and suddenly the weekend is gone.
Sometimes they're straightforward implementations of real-life time sinks like Poker or Blackjack. I can play an hour or two of those and wash my hands of it. Then there's something like Gwent, which I cite as the reason why I still haven't beaten The Witcher 3. You can't just stick a card game like that into an RPG and expect me to not obsessively play for weeks on end.
So, if I show you a screenshot of a game-within-a-game, can you name the game it's from? You've got 10 minutes to complete the quiz, and I'd love to hear how you did once you've finished.

title: Diablo 4's anniversary event brings back the game's most iconic location, and boy that music is sending me
text:
Diablo 4's current Season of Hell's Legacy is focused on celebrating the 30th anniversary of the series, which debuted all the way back in 1997. As part of that effort, Blizzard has been reaching back into the past to bring back iconic characters and enemies like Deckard Cain, Baal, Mephisto, and of course the Big D himself.
The recent discovery of Rune word recipes from Diablo 2 had players wondering if maybe Blizzard has any other blasts from the past stashed away in the new season , and as discovered by redditor JT99-FirstBallot, the answer is a very big yes.
I found Diablo 1 Old Tristram!  from  r/diablo4 Tristram, of course, is the village that serves as the home base of the original Diablo, where players go to buy and sell items, and interact with a range of sadly doomed NPCs like Griswold, Ogden, Pepin, and Wirt. But it's more than just that: As the hub of what is arguably gaming's most influential action RPG, Tristram is a seminal piece of digital landscape, burned into the memories of old-time Diablo fans—and its destruction sometime prior to the events of Diablo 2 (sorry, mild spoiler there) was a genuine bummer.
What's particularly impressive here is how faithful this recreation of Tristram is. The visuals are obviously dramatically improved (although it looks just as I remember it—isn't the human mind a wonderful thing?) but the layout is spot on, and all the characters are there, doing what they do. What really lands for me, though, is the audio: I'm not a Diablo fan by any stretch these days (I haven't touched the series since Diablo 2) but that Tristram guitar riff hits like a truck, and Griswold's voice, well—that's Griswold's voice!
But the attention to detail runs even deeper. As YouTuber MacroBioBoi explains, this Tristram can be turned into Uber Tristram , a special zone previously only accessible during the Pandemonium Event from the Diablo 2 expansion Lord of Destruction. Uber Tristram is basically a copy of the destroyed village seen in the first act of Diablo 2, with one big expansion: You have to fight Baal, Mephisto, and Diablo at the same time . The payoff for kicking all that Prime Evil ass is the Hellfire Torch , an extremely powerful charm—and yes, the Hellfire Torch reward is waiting for you in Diablo 4 now, too.
Blizzard is clearly going hard to recapture the magic of Diablo's glory days for the 30th anniversary, and going deep too. Which naturally leads to the question: What else is in there? It certainly seems like there's more up the sleeve: The Uber Tristram bosses also drop a new item that players are still trying to figure out what to do with.
Now that Diablo 5 is coming—though not until 2029—there are no more expansions planned for Diablo 4 , and seasons will be the focus. Blizzard says we can expect more storytelling though. Namely, it needs to bring about the apocalyptic return of Diablo to set up the events of the sequel, which will take place after Sanctuary has fallen to the forces of evil .

title: Zero Parades: Director's Cut will challenge you to drive a stolen truck through a busy roundabout while stoned out of your mind
text:
Just four months after the release of Zero Parades: For Dead Spies , and two months after laying off a significant number of employees, Studio ZA/UM has announced Zero Parades: Director's Cut, a major update that will add roughly 40,000 words of new content, a new encounter, and other improvements and fixes.
From the announcement on Steam : "Zero Parades: Director's Cut is the definitive edition of our espionage RPG, bringing more story, scenery and mind-fuckery to discover during your bid to reunite The Whole Sick Crew. And yes, we heard you: that includes more Melita."
All due respect to Melita, but the real centerpiece of the Director's Cut appears to be Quisach Roundabout, a new "dramatic encounter" about escaping the titular roundabout. As someone who lives in a country where roundabouts are still relatively new and rare, I'd say that sounds relatable, but apparently this adventure runs a little deeper than just having to figure out which lane you're supposed to be in.
"Hershel and her old friend Ramses find themselves stoned out of their minds, behind the wheel of a hijacked tuk-tuk and seemingly unable to escape the Quisach Roundabout late at night. The objective seems simple enough: take the right exit and head home. Fail to do so, and well... things might get existential. And possibly fatal."
The Director's Cut also offers a new "backstage mode," providing a look at technical insights into the game's development, cut content, and stories from art director Kaspar Tamsalu, new clothing, interactions, death screens, and "atmospheric additions," various quality of life improvements, "and loads more."
Zero Parades: Director's Cut sounds a lot like Disco Elysium: The Final Cut , which brought full voice acting, new characters, a new location, and more to the acclaimed 2019 RPG. But there's one notable difference: Where The Final Cut arrived a year and a half after Disco Elysium's release, Zero Parades: Director's Cut is dropping just four months after the original release. The relatively muted response to Zero Parades compared to Disco Elysium may be a factor in that seeming rush, particularly given that the studio previously cited that shortcoming as the reason for layoff of up to 32 people that was announced in July.
In any event, the response to the Director's Cut from Zero Parades fans is very positive, and it does represent a second chance of sorts for the game: It's coming as a free update for current owners on October 1, and will also mark the game's launch on PlayStation 5, which is set to happen on November 3.

title: Denuvo is on the hunt for DRM cracker 'voices38' as the company attempts to take one of its biggest foes to court
text:
As reported by TorrentFreak , the ubiquitous DRM producer, Denuvo, is attempting to take one of its biggest foes to court over their work circumventing the antipiracy measures on games like Hogwarts Legacy and Black Myth: Wukong. The case is unique in that it comes from Denuvo and not one of the individual copyright-holders of an affected game.
The target of the lawsuit, who goes by "voices38" on various channels, is particularly prolific when it comes to putting out DRM-circumventing patches or "cracks" for games that license Denuvo's copy protection software. Denuvo is suing voices38 under the anti-circumvention provisions of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), which prohibits tampering with digital protections.
While voices38 is an anonymous actor, Denuvo lists a number of social and gaming services accounts associated with them in its filing, an indication that the company will likely subpoena Valve, Reddit, and/or Discord for identifying information. We saw a similar move from Rockstar recently as it attempted to uncover the identity of GTA6 leaker Cyberleek.
"On information and belief, Defendant is an individual who has circumvented Denuvo’s technological measures that effectively control access to copyrighted works," Denuvo wrote in its filing with the Northern District of California. "Defendant has further announced, posted, or disclosed online, including through Reddit, how to circumvent Denuvo's technological measures that effectively control access to copyrighted works, facilitating or allowing others to similarly circumvent those controls and access video games without authorization."
Denuvo's software is largely unpopular with gamers, pirates or paying customers, as it is seen as invasive and a drain on system resources ( Denuvo claims that its software does not affect game performance), but major publishers still turn to it as an antipiracy measure. Denuvo's legal strategy echoes the successful actions taken by Bungie and Activision against cheat developers for their competitive multiplayer games⁠. In addition to keeping up in the anticheat arms race, some companies have taken to suing cheat makers out of existence.
But part of what let them pursue that strategy is the fact that developing hacks for multiplayer games had evolved into a grey market business with identifiable, profit-making entities to sue, while piracy is more diffuse and inherently not a moneymaker. Successfully unmasking voices38 is the cornerstone of any successful legal action by Denuvo.
Voices38 does not seem particularly bothered by the threat, or they're just playing it very, very cool. "All is fine, everything will continue as normal," they wrote in a comment on the piracy-focused CrackWatch subreddit.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever players are reliving 2004 with hour-long queue times to get into the highly-anticipated beta
text:
WoW: Forever , Blizzard's modernized twist on WoW Classic, launched a beta today, but most people have only experienced a login screen so far.
Following a live Q&A, Blizzard turned the WoW: Forever beta servers on. The queue times weren't too bad to start: I had about a nine-minute wait when I first logged in. But once it finished, I was disconnected and kicked to the back of the line for another, even longer queue.
It appears I'm not the only one who has made it past the queue only to be disconnected and prompted to start the whole process over again. Players and streamers are all reporting similar issues, although some people have successfully made it in.
Blizzard acknowledged the issues on X : "We're working through some final issues, and we expect the doors to open soon."
Thank you to everyone waiting to get into the WoW: Forever Beta.We're working through some final issues, and we expect the doors to open soon.Thank you for your patience! September 17, 2026
There doesn't seem to be any trick to the queue. You just need to wait it out and pray that it lets you past the initial login screen.
WoW: Forever is the first version of WoW that doesn't use realms, or servers, in the same way as the others. Instead of picking a realm, you pick a ruleset (normal, PvP, or Roleplay) and join the same server as everyone else. Blizzard did it this way to help preserve the social aspect of the original MMO. This might also be why the queue times are so rough.
Wowhead and others have been busy datamining the game's files for new details. You can already go through all the new class talent trees and peek at some of the reworked armor sets . It might be worth taking a look while you wait to get in, or, if you're like me and don't want to spoil everything, cross your fingers and hope you can play a little before the risk of long queues gets even worse on the weekend.
There will be plenty of time to play the WoW: Forever beta, however. It'll stick around until October 21 before Blizzard fixes it up for its November 4 launch.

title: Wardogs is the only FPS where I actually expect to get revived
text:
There exists in classed-based military shooters an understanding: Never count on a random medic to care about you.
You'd think in games where players have to opt into the support role, it'd be as simple as "There's a medic nearby, they'll try to get me," but any Battlefield player will tell you how often trained doctors trample over their corpse, more hungry to end a life than save one. So you learn to assume that you're on your own, and when a real medic does go out of their way to help you, they're the exception that proves the rule.
Wardogs is different. Help is so abundant in this 100-player, three-team milsim that, when I die, I can be confident a second, third, or even a fourth chance is coming. It's the only FPS I've played where multiple medics will actually race to give me first-aid, drag my body to safety, or pop a smoke grenade to cover a revive.
I've also played shooters where support play is taken more seriously than in Battlefield—Squad, Hell Let Loose, Isonzo, Arma, and other games on the "milsim" spectrum come to mind—but Bulkhead has successfully crafted a medic role so accessible and appealing that damn near everyone in Wardogs wants to help. Official stats from Wardogs' first weekend reveal that players earned 123 million kills and 61 million revives for an overall resurrection rate of nearly 50%. As a lifelong medic main, that's astounding.
How does Wardogs do it? I think a lot of factors contribute:
(Image credit: Bulkhead) Money, obviously
The big one is Wardogs' unique, cash-infused incentive structure. Unlike an extraction shooter, where money is earned primarily through kills and selling valuable loot, Wardogs will make you rich just for doing useful, nonviolent things for the team: killing, capturing, transporting, spotting, building, and healing .
On top of the fuzzy feelings I get for helping out, Medic is a very profitable playstyle in Wardogs. A single revive pays almost as much as a kill, and that's before you factor in tips from grateful patients and automatic assist payouts when those patients go on to get more kills. If I go the extra mile of buying spare bandages to heal folks back to 100, I get even more cash and tips.
Battlefield 6 also showers dedicated medics with XP, and really good ones end up near the top of the scoreboard, but Wardogs' cash prizes feel more impactful because it's the currency that fuels everything you do. Going on a 50k profit run in a single life can mean I've taken a big step toward unlocking an expensive upgrade, or it can mean that I get to splurge on my next loadout with a bigger backpack or vehicle. It's smart stuff.
(Image credit: Bulkhead) Anyone can revive
You don't have to invest in medic gear to lend a hand. Anyone can drag bodies and revive friendlies, and the vendor gives away a single-use quick-revive tool once per life. There's a world where this design choice could've been controversial in Wardogs, because if anyone can revive, what do you need proper medics for? But Bulkhead has threaded the needle perfectly by making manual "hand" revives—where your soldier literally rubs their hands together for ~20 seconds like they're charging defibrillators paddles—extremely slow.
Teammates can and will try to save you this way, but upgrading to proper defibrillators (unlocked at medic level 11) is a dramatic upgrade. A kitted-up medic can have a full squad back on its feet in the same time as a single hand revive. And even though there are no enforced classes in Wardogs, defibs are expensive and take up your one "specialist" tool slot that could hold an RPG or binoculars instead. It's possible to carry more than one specialist tool, but you need a huge backpack to accommodate that playstyle (which is even more expensive). This ensures that anyone can heal, but not everyone can be a proper medic.
(Image credit: Team17) It's not that dangerous to be a medic
I have found that going for a revive in Wardogs is not as risky as in similar games. Often (but not always) when I sprint toward a dead body out in the open, I'm able to drag them behind cover without drama.
I suspect this has to do with how spread out the action is in Wardogs: a three-team structure means there's no singular front where all of the death happens, which also means there's not a single pile of dead bodies that enemies are staring at, waiting for medics to make a move. No, most of my Wardogs skirmishes have been smaller in scale—confrontations with two or three clustered enemies or a showdown with a single sniper I can't even see.
It's a stark contrast to Battlefield 6, where some maps are so congested (and the time-to-kill so short) that the three seconds it takes to equip defibs and use them is enough for someone to sprint around a corner and shoot you in the face. Wardogs' pace is far better suited for support play.
(Image credit: Bulkhead) Bribing is fun, but not as important as I thought
The bribes help. As Sean highlighted last week the ability to bribe nearby medics up to $500 to pick you up can grease the wheels in desperate scenarios. For the first few days of Wardogs, I'd max out my bribe every time because it was cheaper than losing a whole loadout, but I've noticed lately that many players will attempt a revive regardless because, as we've covered, the base pay for a revive is incentive enough.
(Image credit: Bulkhead) Dead players don't give up, because dying costs time and money
Wardogs is unique in its commitment to death costing time. There are no Battlefield-like squad spawns, no rally points, and not even FOBs themselves are respawn beacons. There are only two ways to get back in the action: Use your team's one APC (a mobile respawn vehicle with a long cooldown after use) or hitch a ride for the 3km journey from HQ.
Both options are more expensive, and often significantly slower, than just waiting for a revive. I can't overemphasize how important that is, because it means that dead players choose to be patient and give medics a chance. There's nothing I hate more as a support player than folks giving up on me as I'm trying to stick my neck out for them, but so far in Wardogs, this has happened exactly once.
It's still really early days for Wardogs, and the game itself keeps changing as players unlock increasingly elaborate tools, but I'm impressed with how well its rules, scale, gadgets, and incentives coalesce around cooperation. The medic role might be the best example of that synergy in action.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker sequel may not have the divisive time mechanic that so many players dislike: 'We will not force it,' game director says
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker is a pretty excellent RPG, but there's one aspect of it that not everyone loves: Time. Simply put, it's a limited resource in the game, which restricts what Coen—that's you—can do. Our reviewer, Australian editor Shaun Prescott, found it injected a sense of urgency into the game , at least in the early going, but said he'd "also like to pick some nirnroot and play some Gwent, thank you very much"—that is, have the time to relax and fiddle with non-essential tasks on his own terms, at his own pace.
Other players clearly felt the same way: One of the first mods to come out for The Blood of Dawnwalker is the " Better Story Timer ," which effectively eliminates the impact of the ticking clock entirely—and which has since become, by far, the most popular Dawnwalker mod on Nexus Mods.
How much of an impact that reaction has had over at developer Rebel Wolves is impossible to say, but in an interview with Eurogamer , studio CEO and game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz said it might not be used for the game's sequel.
"We will play with it. If we will have parts of the story, or the whole story, to which it fits, then we will use it," Tomaszkiewicz said. "If we will have stories where it does not fit, we will not force it. We will play with this system and we will try to use it to boost the urgency of some events in the game. But I'm not saying that in every game we will have the same scheme or loop—it's not like this."
Tomaszkiewicz acknowledged complaints about the time mechanic, and the mods available to remove it. He doesn't have a problem with that, but he does encourage players to try Dawnwalker with the clock running first: "We balanced [Dawnwalker] in a way that it's possible to do around 80 percent of the content with the time mechanic so it's not so bad.
"The arguments of, 'I want to see everything in one playthrough,' I understand, but it's false to begin with, because even in games like The Witcher, you cannot see everything in one playthrough because you have choices and consequences, and different things happen when you choose different things," Tomaszkiewicz said.
I have that same feeling myself with most games—I want to see everything the first time—but Tomaszkiewicz is correct: The Witcher 2 forces players to make a choice at a critical juncture that unavoidably excludes a significant amount of gameplay, and that seemed fine; Obsidian's Pentiment , released to acclaim in 2022, has a very strict time mechanic of its own that's essential to the experience. Missing out on things in videogames is not all that new or unusual—if anything, it's the inevitable outcome of choice in videogames that so many players say they want.
Interestingly, Tomaszkiewicz said that complaints about the time mechanic have tailed off considerably now that Dawnwalker has been out for a couple weeks, because people have finished the game and realized they actually had more time than they needed—a pattern he expects to continue as players continue to wrap it up.
"There will always be people who will have a problem with that because they don't like time mechanics at all, but I think that is fine," he said. "They can download the mod and play without it if they want."
And yes, even though The Blood of Dawnwalker has only been out for a couple weeks, Rebel Wolves is already eyeballing a sequel: The studio is now looking for a lead writer to help "craft the next chapter in the Dawnwalker saga."

title: Hideo Kojima announces Bill Skarsgård will star in stealth-action Physint, legendary designer Yoji Shinkawa also confirmed for character design
text:
Hideo Kojima took to his social media channels earlier today to announce Bill Skarsgård as the new lead for his upcoming stealth-action game, Physint. He also reaffirmed some of the game's casting announcements from before it changed hands from PlayStation to Xbox after a seemingly messy split with Sony. Physint's top-billed cast are:
Bill Skarsgård
Charlee Fraser
Don Lee
Minami Hambe
Alongside the casting announcement, Kojima shared a new poster for Physint featuring Skarsgård, Fraser, and the new tagline "The Next Cold War Begins." Tucked away at the bottom is, perhaps, the most exciting news for me personally: Third-billed on production behind Hideo Kojima and Hideo Kojima is the GOAT, Yoji Shinkawa, on "character and mechanical design."
The longtime Kojima collaborator and Metal Gear character artist also worked at Kojima Productions on Death Stranding, but it's comforting to get confirmation he was unaffected by the recent production dust-up.
Speaking of Physint's continuity, Fraser, Lee, and Hamabe had all been confirmed in a prior Kojima Productions announcement about Physint's cast. Skarsgård as leading man John Physint (working name) is the only new casting info⁠—though, like with Shinkawa, it's probably worth clarifying after everything that's happened.
I was initially disappointed. Based on John Physint's shadowy appearance in the game's first teaser, I was hoping Kojima would spring for Robert Pattinson in the role. He's a known gamer on a bit of an all-time career hot-streak, and feels like a perfect fit for Kojima's oeuvre. Skarsgård was pretty great in Robert Eggers' 2024 Nosferatu, though, and I can only hope he brings a similarly unsettling, sexual energy to Physint.
Kojima seems to be spinning up marketing for the game again now that Microsoft has scooped it from Sony. The PlayStation parent company reportedly cut Kojima off for going over budget and missing deadlines. There's been no definitive word, but it's hard to imagine that Kojima will be allowed to keep using Sony and Guerilla Games' proprietary Decima engine (which also powered Death Stranding) now that he's left the fold, potentially delaying this game that already felt like it was years away.
Kojima's other big upcoming project, O.D.—also published by Xbox⁠—looks much closer to release. Its "Knock" trailer from last year makes it look like a return to some of the ideas explored in Kojima's legendary demo for the canceled Silent Hills, P.T.

title: If you can't get enough of record-breaking Emmy winner Matthew Rhys, his newest TV series is based on an '80s Sega game, and is out now
text:
Matthew Rhys is having quite a moment. The actor cleaned up at the Emmys on Monday, making history by becoming the first man to win two Emmys for a leading role on the same night (for comedy series Widow's Bay and limited series The Beast in Me).
And in doing that, he actually set another record by becoming the only person to receive a lead actor Emmy for all three genres—he'd already won one for drama series The Americans back in 2018.
And his moment continues: Rhys actually has yet another new show out this week. Golden Axe is an animated comedy based on the Golden Axe video game series made by Sega way back in 1989. All 10 episodes are streaming now on Paramount+.
Joining Rhys, who plays dwarf warrior Gilius Thunderhead, is Danny Pudi (of Community and Mythic Quest) and Liam McIntyre (he played JD Fenix in Gears of War 4). Improv comedy fans will also be thrilled to hear the voice of Lisa Gilroy, playing sorceress Tyris, and Cart Tart, who voices… let me see if I've got this right… a humanoid panther.
"In an homage to Sega's iconic 1989 video game, Golden Axe follows legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare and Gilius Thunderhead as they reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead," says Paramount+. "Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all."
I'm a fan of just about the entire cast, and while I haven't seen it yet—and in fact only heard about the show for the first time today, and I've never played the games, either—I'm gonna check it out. If, like me, you're not subscribed to Paramount+ because you simply aren't interested in 26 different Taylor Sheridan shows, you can still see the first two episodes of Golden Axe for free on YouTube here and here . title: Magic: The Gathering's next big crossover is with itself
text:
Over the last three years, since the Wilds of Eldraine set, Magic: The Gathering's core expansions have been building to a climactic storyline. It's very comic book, a multiverse-threatening crossover that's been set off by the planeswalker Jace Beleren trying to create a new multiverse, one that's free of all the threats Magic's setting has faced in recent years—Phyrexians, Eldrazi, etcetera—but which will overwrite the existing multiverse once it's complete.
This sets up a bunch of mirror matches where famous planeswalkers face off against their doppelgangers: the pyromantic Chandra versus a cryomantic version of herself while none-more-goth necromancer Liliana is up against a version of herself who practices life magic and, horrifyingly, wears white.
Of course, not everyone playing Magic knows who all these characters are. Tomik Vrona, for instance, is a member of the shady Orzhov Syndicate who excels in finding legal loopholes. If you know him as a lawyer for the magic Mafia, seeing him in Reality Fracture as a sparkmage who delights in breaking not only the laws of the legal system but also physics comes as a bit of a shock. If you don't know all that Tomik lore, it's not going to land as hard.
Which is why Reality Fracture's booster packs will give you an echoed pair together. You'll be able to see both versions of Tomik, or Ajani, or whoever at the same time and understand the contrast between them.
Wizards of the Coast Wizards of the Coast For me, Magic is often a social game, living up to the Gathering in its name. It's an excuse to sling cards and chat to people without having to care about poker or whatever. The setting and characters are secondary to the play, and the sweeping drama of Jace's girlfriend breaking up with him so hard he rewrote reality, or whatever is actually going on, is always going to be secondary to the jokes we make around the table.
I'm glad that someone on the production team did the hard work to insure paired cards would land in packs together, because it means I get to see a fire wizard and an ice wizard together and know exactly what's happening without having to know the events of a tie-in novel trilogy or a six-issue limited series.
Reality Fracture will be available digitally in Arena on September 29 and will have its global release on October 2, with pre-release events starting on September 25.
